g.text: Revision C prototype · component side · 55.88 x 88.90 mm board
Labels identify component locations; this is not the printed silkscreen.
J1: 9 V power · J2: input · J3: output · J7: momentary footswitch
J4: time · J5: feedback · J6: mix · J8: LED · JP1: removable power link
Square pad = pin 1. Values and wiring labels are on the next page.
Remove JP1 before USB. Use MCP6002 at U3 and 23LC1024 at U4.
Use this map for locations; use the back view and BOM for values.
Unbuilt design: firmware, bench tests and enclosure fit remain to be validated.
